create.name: Jogos centras PRANA
create.bio:
Jogos centras PRANA is a classical Sivananda yoga studio in Kaunas, Lithuania's second city, run as a non-profit and recognised by the International Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres as an affiliated branch. Its teachers all completed the organisation's teacher training, and they pass on the method of Swami Sivananda and Swami Vishnudevananda in the form they received it. The centre's site honours senior Sivananda teachers such as Swami Sivadasananda and Swami Durgananda, and it works alongside the organisation's own centre in Vilnius. The studio is in the Šilainiai district, with a large wooden-floored practice hall and a small sitting room.

Newcomers begin with Joga-1, a month-long course meeting twice a week that teaches the sun salutation, the twelve basic postures, two breathing practices and the principles behind them, followed by a continuation course, Joga-2. After that, students join open classes on weekday evenings and Saturday mornings. Satsang, with silent meditation, mantra chanting and a talk on Vedanta, is held early on several mornings each week without charge, after an introductory lecture. The centre also runs themed seminars, private lessons and two family yoga camps in the countryside each summer, with vegetarian meals and the choice of cabins or tents.

courses.title: Joga pradedantiems (Joga-1)
courses.description: A month-long beginners' course meeting twice a week, open to complete newcomers and to people from other yoga styles. It covers the sun salutation, the twelve basic Sivananda postures, kapalabhati and alternate-nostril breathing, relaxation and the core ideas of the tradition. A new group starts each month.

courses.title: Sivananda joga kursas pažengusiems (Joga-2)
courses.description: The follow-on month for those who have finished Joga-1, again meeting twice a week, adding knowledge and practice that prepare students for the open classes or for practising at home.

courses.title: 10 kartų abonementas
courses.description: A ten-visit card for the open Sivananda classes, valid for three months. A monthly pass for up to five classes a week, single visits and private lessons are listed on the same timetable and price page.

courses.title: Vasaros jogos stovyklos
courses.description: Two summer yoga camps each year in a quiet rural setting for the whole family, with yoga, meditation and vegetarian meals. Guests stay in cabins or bring a tent, and can join for the full week or a single day. Dates are announced by email.

free_resources.title: Meditacija – Satsangas
free_resources.description: Group meditation at the studio in three parts: silent sitting, kirtan chanting and a reading or talk on Vedanta and yoga psychology. Attendance is free once you have heard the introductory lecture on meditation; the page also gives the chant texts.
